columns.label: Data (e hora de início, se aplicável)
columns.hint: Keep literal date/time text. Confirm the actual ISO date separately; never infer it from this cell.

columns.label: Localização
columns.hint: Keep the supplied location; do not infer LPIS identifiers or coordinates.

columns.label: Tipo de utilização/cultura (código OEPP)
columns.hint: Keep crop/use and OEPP text; the source cell's date formatting does not define a crop date.

columns.label: Estado fenológico (BBCH)
columns.hint: Keep stage text, ranges and leading zeros; no code validity is inferred.

columns.label: Inimigo
columns.hint: Keep the actual target or purpose; no product-label inference.

columns.label:
Área tratada
(ha ou m2)
columns.hint: Preserve the value and explicit original unit; do not assume hectares or convert.

columns.label: N.º de aplicador
columns.hint: Identifier text, including leading zeros; never a numeric counter.

columns.label: Nome
columns.hint: Product name, distinct from producer and applicator.

columns.label: Número de autorização
columns.hint: Product-authorisation identifier, not the seller's activity authorisation.

columns.label: Estabelecimento de venda
columns.hint: Actual selling establishment; do not substitute producer or applicator.

columns.label: N.º de autorização de exercício de atividade
columns.hint: Seller activity-authorisation identifier; no identifier grammar is inferred.

columns.label: Quant. de produto aplicado (kg ou L) ou dose (kg ou L/ha ou m²)
columns.hint: Keep amount/dose and unit/basis text verbatim. No classification, multiplication or conversion.

columns.label: Volume de calda  (L)
columns.hint: Actual spray-mixture volume in printed L; not product quantity, irrigation or water abstraction.

limitations: Literal manual preparation only. Legal applicability, mandatory cells, retention, product authorisation and recipient acceptance remain unresolved.
No authority upload, official XML/XLSX conformity, signature or filing is provided.
The source's sixteen slots define derivative display blocks, not a legal record limit. No quantity, dose, area or mixture totals are inferred.
The app-selected year is not printed in the source; only separately confirmed actual dates select rows.
A September 2026 source publication does not establish a 2026 machine-readable record mandate.
